title: Google's SynthID watermark is hard to break, but it doesn't solve AI disinformation
summary: Content that gets passed around the Internet degrades from compression, resizing, and edits, but Google says SynthID should still be present even in well-worn memes. For instance, Google’s detector doesn’t recognize OpenAI’s watermark, and OpenAI’s detector doesn’t recognize Google’s watermark.
